title: Grammar — Adjectives and Adverbs (My Next Grammar, Lessons 15-16)
intro: Adjectives describe nouns. They can come before nouns or after a be verb. Adverbs tell more about verbs and often end in -ly.

items.q: Which word is the adjective? The girl has a pretty dress.
Which word is the adjective? Seoul is a big city.
Choose the best adjective: My room is ____. I just cleaned it.
Choose the best adjective: My brother is six years old. He is ____.
Choose the best adjective: I don't like hot summers. I like ____ winters.
